sentences.en: Branching and merging are two basic operations of revision control.
sentences.zh: 分支和合并是版本控制中的两种基本操作。

sentences.en: I quickly realized that my text needed an exhaustive revision.
sentences.zh: 我很快意识到我的文本需要进行彻底的修改。

sentences.en: This revision of Darwin's ideas came under fire from academic positions.
sentences.zh: 对达尔文思想的这次修订遭到了学术界的猛烈批评。

senses.zh: 修正；修订本；复习 形容词: revisionary
